xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1 - The above Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results were reviewed and recommended by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at their respective meetings held on 4th November, 2026. The limited review of the Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 33(3)(c)(i) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015, has been carried out by the Statutory Auditors of the Company.

2 - The Company has only one reportable primary business segment i.e. Electrical and other Cables, Wires, Conductors, Accessories for Cables and Conductors, Products for quality power solutions eg. Capacitors and Capacitor Banks, Harmonic Filters, SVGs, etc. and Turnkey Projects predominantly relating thereto, based on guiding principles given in Ind AS-108 "Operating Segments" notified pursuant to Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 (as amended). Accordingly, the disclosure requirements as per Ind AS-108 are not applicable.

3 - The Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2025 have been prepared, interalia, considering the unaudited consolidated financial results of an Associate Company viz. Vindhya Telelinks Limited (VTL). During the previous quarter, the Company has retrospectively restated its consolidated financial statements/results to give effect to the consolidation of the financial results of its three wholly owned subsidiaries, namely August Agents Ltd., Insilco Agents Ltd. and Laneseda Agents Ltd. Accordingly, the accompanying comparative consolidated financial results for the corresponding previous period have also been restated. The impact of the restatement is summarised below:

(i) Impact on the consolidated statement of profit and loss -

a - Total Income For Quarter ended 30.09.2025 is 82426.55 (Reported) and 82426.55 (Restated) and for hald year ended 30.09.2025 is 142684.98 (Reported) and 142684.98 (Restated).
b - Total expenses For Quarter ended 30.09.2025 is 77675.39 (Reported) and 77675.39 (Restated) and for hald year ended 30.09.2025 is 135182.21 (Reported) and 135182.21 (Restated).
c- Profit before tax (after considerting share of associates) is 6180.07 (Reported) and 6258.88 (Restated) and for hald year ended 30.09.2025 is 10724.19 (Reported) and 10894.51 (Restated).
d- Profit after tax is 4768.14 (Reported) and 4827.13 (Restated) and for hald year ended 30.09.2025 is 8059.47 (Reported) and 8186.94 (Restated).
e- Total Comprehensive Income is 2334.15 (Reported) and 2393.14 (Restated) and for hald year ended 30.09.2025 is 11327.27 (Reported) and 11454.74 (Restated).
f- Earning per share(basic and diluted) is 13.74 (Reported) and 13.91 (Restated) and for hald year ended 30.09.2025 is 23.23 (Reported) and 23.59(Restated).

(ii)Impact on the consolidated balance sheet for year ended 31.03.2026 -

a- Total assets reported 432309.46 and restated is 433724.66.
b- Total liability reported 243208.69 and restated is 243564.87.
c- Other Equity reported 189100.77 and restated is 190159.79.

4 - The figures of the previous periods/year are re-classified/re-grouped, wherever necessary, to correspond with the current period’s classification and disclosure.
